text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Amazing, amazing, aaaamaaazing♡ Big Sis 
looks so super pretty!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, King is supposed to be used to 
parties, so why does she look a little 
nervous?"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Now, now, eveeeeryone! I know it's hard 
to look away from our brilliant Muses... 
but the real show starts right now!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"The truth is, for this Racewear unveiling 
party, our Muses each wrote a letter 
addressed to the person they want to show 
their outfits to!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Dressed in special Racewear for that 
special someone—now is the time to share 
your feelings!!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Well then, I shall go first. It is 
somewhat embarrassing, but—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "To my stubborn, headstrong self."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"‘Tell me, you. 
The you who cries in secret, hiding away 
so that no one will see.’"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"‘There is just one thing I wanted to tell 
you today, which is why I decided to write 
this letter—’"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"‘You've been labeled as lacking talent, 
and unable to accept that, you lash out in 
defiance.’"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"‘The crown remains out of reach, and 
though you want to fall to your knees in 
despair, you refuse to allow yourself that 
weakness.’"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"‘Deep down, all you really wanted was for 
someone to praise you and say you're 
amazing. 
And yet—you could never bring yourself to 
say it out loud...’"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"‘I know you are suffering, struggling 
with a self that refuses to change. 
I know the pain of feeling like you almost 
hate who you are.’"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"‘That is why there is only one thing I 
want to say—’"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "‘"You are fine just the way you are"...’"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"‘Because at the end of the path you ran 
without changing yourself, stands the me 
of today... a me who has surpassed 
first-rate.’"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"‘I became someone acknowledged by myself, 
not by anyone else.’"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"‘So keep on running, just as you are. 
—To the stubborn me of the past... from 
the me who is truly top-class.’"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ......Keep running just as I am, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I wrote a letter to Grandma! I'll let 
everyone else listen in as a special 
treat, so you'd better listen closely!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"‘—To Grandma. 
Hey, did you see that?! I managed to cast 
magic!’"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"‘You can't use magic unless you believe 
in it. 
And yet, nobody believed in magic—’"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"‘So I cast it right in front of their 
faces! 
Everyone was totally dumbfounded, it was 
so funny!’"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"‘I think everyone finally understands 
what magic is now! 
If you believe you can do it and that 
nothing is impossible, any wish can come 
true!’"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"‘P.S.! After I used my magic, I got a new 
witch outfit as a reward! 
It's super cute and I love it♪ From 
Sweepy, the future Great Witch.’"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, my Racewear got turned into a 
witch outfit...

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"Ahahaha! Splendidly done, my sweet little 
Sweepy!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Well, she looks thrilled, so I suppose 
that's fine, right? 
...Now then, for our final Muse: 
Verxina-chan—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's finally time—Big Sis...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Up until today, I agonized over what 
to write. 
I couldn't think of any words that could 
truly capture how I felt..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Riiiiip!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Eeeeeek!?!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—No words needed. 
I want to show it through how I stand 
here.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"The one who will defeat you is me." 
I swear it on this racing outfit—!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Watching the Broadcast
text_block_list.text: Whoa! So intense! Wait, this message—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaah~~♡ 
Big sis is so pretty! So cool!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I want to be just like that— 
Eeeeeeeh!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Miss Beauty! 
Listen, listen! I'm gonna become a muse 
too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll become a muse and wear a super 
pretty, sparkly, super-duper celebrity 
racing outfit just like my big sis!!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, yet another wonderful rough diamond 
right here—and over there too?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing right through me like that kinda 
stings~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. I'm not gonna lose either, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll have to show it. 
The kind of strength that I can truly 
acknowledge in myself—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And you know what, Miss Beauty! 
I have some requests for my racing outfit♡ 
Will you hear me out?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
First, I want to show off my collarbones, 
so off-the-shoulder would be great~♡ 
And I think a sweetheart neckline would be 
super cute♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And then, lots and loooots of jewels 
scattered along the hem— 
Oh, and I want to include matching designs 
with my big sis too!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh goodness, what a greedy little rough 
diamond you are! 
...Though, I don't dislike that one bit!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The BDC supports the beauty of every 
single Umamusume! 
We are always eagerly awaiting your 
challenge at our auditions~~!!
